vocabulary.definition: A round red, green, or yellow fruit
vocabulary.exampleSentence: I eat an apple for lunch.

vocabulary.definition: A round object used to play games
vocabulary.exampleSentence: The ball is red and round.

vocabulary.definition: A small furry animal that people keep as a pet
vocabulary.exampleSentence: My cat likes to sleep on the bed.

vocabulary.definition: An animal that barks and is a popular pet
vocabulary.exampleSentence: The dog runs in the park.

vocabulary.definition: To take food into your mouth and swallow it
vocabulary.exampleSentence: I eat breakfast in the morning.

vocabulary.definition: An animal that lives in water and has fins
vocabulary.exampleSentence: The fish swims in the tank.

vocabulary.definition: To move from one place to another
vocabulary.exampleSentence: Let's go to school now.

vocabulary.definition: Feeling or showing joy and pleasure
vocabulary.exampleSentence: I am happy when I play with my friends.

vocabulary.definition: A building where people live
vocabulary.exampleSentence: I live in a blue house.

vocabulary.definition: To push yourself up into the air with your legs
vocabulary.exampleSentence: I jump very high.

vocabulary.definition: Being nice and caring about others
vocabulary.exampleSentence: My teacher is kind to all the students.

vocabulary.definition: To care deeply about someone or something

vocabulary.definition: To create or produce something

vocabulary.definition: The word by which a person or thing is known
vocabulary.exampleSentence: My name is Priya.

vocabulary.definition: A round orange fruit that is sweet and juicy
vocabulary.exampleSentence: I eat an orange for a snack.

vocabulary.definition: To have fun and enjoy yourself
vocabulary.exampleSentence: Children play in the park.

vocabulary.definition: Done or happening fast

vocabulary.definition: To look at and understand written words

vocabulary.definition: The bright star that gives light and heat to Earth

vocabulary.exampleSentence: The tree has many green leaves.
